title: Fasmora 3.3000.6420 is available
message: A smoother, more capable Fasmora: resume downloads, identify media, translate pages inline, and read offline with stronger popup controls.
whatsNew: Paused downloads resume from where they stopped, with stronger HLS recovery.
Detected media shows clearer file names, sizes, and media types before download.
Translate full webpages inline and save pages for offline reading or Reader mode.
Stronger ad and popup blocking, with controls to allow popups for a site you trust.
More reliable custom tabs, page previews, and browser navigation.
